reviews.comment: Dr. Marshall is a great guy, but the class is extremly diffuicult. so much info on one slide with fonts that are hard to read. is very picky on exams when grading, lots have the be exact with spelling or you get it wrong. Lab exams are ok but easier than lecture exams. DO YOUR LAB NOTEBOOK! also Do any extra credit offered to you as it WILL help
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The kindest professor ever! Exams are extremely simple if you look at the reviews. The lab practicals are what threw most people off. There is tons of content to learn but it isn't impossible!

Slides are very word heavy with random blanks to fill out, so print the slides out/download them and annotate them instead of hand writing notes. The lab is easy, just don't procrastinate the lab notebook. Take notes, study the review sheet, and do your lab notebook and you'll be fine

He records lectures so attendance isn't mandatory. It's a hard class that requires lots of memorization. He gives reviews for the exams but they are not that helpful. Make sure you memorize the phylogenetic trees and show up for the class before the exam bc he does a review. He is a good professor that is willing to help and answer questions.

This is my favorite professor at my university. His course is genuinely very interesting. However, the lecture portion of your grade (60%) is comprised of only tests. The questions on the test are things you would usually think of as only minor details on the slides. Most people have their hands on an old test though. Lab is HARD.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: All of the grades in his class are from tests and lab. Lab is a lot of work, but not too difficult. His lectures are posted online, so if you miss class you can find his lectures. Really awesome person and very knowledgeable in this field. Tells you exactly what he will ask on the test. Lots of extra credit on the tests as well.

Great professor knows the topic well, and you will learn lots of interesting material. Tests are very hard and he is a picky grader. Only assignments are tests plus lab. Stay on top of work outside of class or you will not do very well in this course.

Great professor. Adds a lot of humor into the lectures. Understands that the class is difficult. Records lectures so you don't HAVE to go to class but it helps. Make sure you take your PowerPoint slides with you to class or you will get lost. Study the review, but don't focus on it alone. Word emails to him professionally, cause he'll chew you out.

He teaches a lot of in depth and very detailed information in each lectures. The tests are also very detailed and very hard. Definitely LOTS of studying time involved to pass. He grades hard but he at least warns you of the intensity.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I thought this instructor is very difficult, he doesnt give extra credit and doesnt give extra points. I didnt skip an assignment and i think i fail,
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher!  But ppt slides have soooo much info on them and the test cover the entire lectures!  You have to know it all!  Good thing is its straight off the ppt if you can memorize everything!  Random quizzes when attendance is low!  Bad part of VERT class is 8-10hrs outside work for just he lab!  Lab is a little excessive.

His vert class is said to be the hardest for marb majors. It's impossible to pass the exams without exams from previous semesters (he doesn't give back the final tho) bc theres lots of material. He will tell you what the essay will be in class if you pay attention. PRACTICE WRITING THE POSSIBLE ESSAYS!!

Class wasnt mandatory but is crucial in passing the class. He puts his lectures online so you can listen to later. Previous exams that you get from other students are REALLY helpful and is the reason why i did so good in the class. The notebooks in lab are easy points to get so do them well!
Make sure to attend every class. In the lab get an early start on the lab notebooks. Make sure you do the reviews!!!!
This is an amazing class.  Dr. Marshall is really interesting and you will learn lots.  The tests are hard; make sure and memorize all the cladograms.

He seems to love the class, WHATEVER YOU DO GO TO HIS REVIEWS THAT IS THE DIFFERENCE IN PASSING! also get old tests from people to study it makes a world of difference.STUDY REALLY REALLY HARD for his first test most don't make over a 40 on it and it screws you the rest of the semester, that is what gets most ppl. learn phylogenic trees! pickytests
I really enjoyed this class! Dr. Marshal makes it very entertaining. The old test are very similar.

This is a great class. Dr. Marshall is a great teacher and the lectures are very good. Go to class and you will be fine. There are old tests floating around, they are good study guides just ask around.

The class itself is a lot of work, but it's very interesting.  Dr. Marshall is an excellent professor and really enjoys teaching this subject.  He always holds review sessions before exams and is willing to help students outside of class.  He also makes the class interesting by acting out the material so you can remember it.  Very fun guy!
Great class - very useful information for other biology classes.  This professor gave really interesting lectures and ALWAYS held review sessions.

Very willing to help outside of class.  Will go over any subject as many times as you need to until you understand.  A fairly hard class but if you actually study and not blow it off then you will do fine.  He wants you to pass and will help you pass.  I found it to be a very interesting course.

He is a great prof and very willing to help outside class.  Has reviews for tests and wants to give A's, but you do have to work for them.  Not an easy class, but necessary and a good GPA booster if you try hard enough.

He is one of the greatest men alive. He is hard but fair. He won't let you do anything but your best. When the chips were down and I wanted to leave, he is the one that made me decide that i wanted to stay, i was a soph then and a senior now...that man is
